test_title: PYST 12: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 15th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A and B can do a job in 10 and 15 days respectively. They work together for 3 days and then B leaves. How many more days will A take to finish the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A can finish work in 10 days

B can finish work in 15 days

A and B worked together for 3 days

**Concept Used:**

Total work = LCM of individual days

Work rate = Total work ÷ Time

Remaining work = Total work − Work done

Time = Remaining work ÷ A’s 1 day work
